title: Astro Portal widget snapshot
description: The compact, non-sensitive snapshot the mobile app hands to its native extensions (iOS widget, Live Activity, Apple Watch, Android widget) after every relevant synchronization -- plan pull, session start/pause/finish, debrief. `additionalProperties: false` is the leak guard: it makes coordinates, tenant/device ids, tokens, and precise place names structurally impossible to carry here, at every level of the object, not just a reviewer's promise. A widget renders this snapshot; it never calls the API, never holds a credential, and never contains the planner. `version` pins the shape a native extension was compiled against: a native reader that finds a different value discards the snapshot and shows its placeholder state rather than guessing at an incompatible layout.

version.description: The snapshot contract's own version. A native reader compiled against a different value treats the snapshot as absent.

generatedAt.description: When the mobile app wrote this snapshot. Lets a native extension detect and label a stale local snapshot (no sync in a long time) without ever reaching the network itself.

nextPlanName.description: The name of the next plan to execute (tonight's or the next observing night's), when one exists.

nextTargetName.description: The next plan's first or current target's display name -- never a catalogue id alone when a friendlier name exists.

nightStartAt.description: The next plan's night start, for a countdown. The system's own date formatting renders it; this snapshot never carries a pre-formatted countdown string.

constraintSummary.description: A short, human-readable summary of the night's binding constraint (weather, Moon, etc.), already localized -- never a structured forecast payload.

activeSession.description: Present only while a session is running on this device (open or paused); absent once it finishes.

currentTargetName.description: The display name of the target currently being executed.

status.description: The session's execution status -- the same vocabulary the Live Activity already shows.
